parlays.title: Best 3-leg parlay
parlays.about: The three legs most likely to all hit, across every game and market (player props, moneylines, spreads, totals), each priced -250 or longer and rated at or above the market.

parlays.title: Safe parlay · Early afternoon (12:00 PM)
parlays.about: The 3 legs most likely to all hit in this window, each rated 68%+ by the model and at or above the no-vig market.

parlays.title: Ladder (double-up) · Early afternoon (12:00 PM)
parlays.about: 2-3 legs priced together at just over even money, chosen for the best chance that every leg hits.

parlays.title: Risky parlay · Early afternoon (12:00 PM)
parlays.about: A bigger payout (+400 to +2000) from legs where the model sees the most value versus the market; expect it to miss more often than it hits.
